```{r tpmVerticalStack, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

# ============================================================
# 1. TRUNCATE TIMESTAMPS + CALCULATE TRANSACTION VOLUME
#    - Group by app_name to keep Application in the tooltip
# ============================================================
tpm_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    minute_mark = as.POSIXct(format(timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:00"), tz = "UTC")
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name, run_id, thread_group, label, minute_mark) %>%
  summarise(tx_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# ============================================================
# 2. COMPUTE TOTAL COUNT PER MINUTE (for tooltip)
#    - Totals are calculated per run/minute across ALL applications
# ============================================================
tpm_totals <- tpm_data %>%
  group_by(run_id, minute_mark) %>%
  summarise(total_per_minute = sum(tx_count), .groups = "drop")

tpm_data <- tpm_data %>%
  left_join(tpm_totals, by = c("run_id", "minute_mark"))

# ============================================================
# 3. COLOR PALETTE ASSIGNMENT
# ============================================================
all_unique_labels  <- sort(unique(tpm_data$label))
set.seed(42)
transaction_colors <- setNames(choose_palette(length(all_unique_labels)), all_unique_labels)

tpm_data <- tpm_data %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = all_unique_labels))

subtitle_text <- paste(sort(unique(tpm_data$run_id)), collapse = " vs ")

# ============================================================
# 4. BUILD GGPLOT
#    - X = Timeline, Y = TPM
#    - Facet side-by-side strictly by run_id
# ============================================================
tpm_plot <- ggplot(
  tpm_data,
  aes(
    x    = minute_mark,
    y    = tx_count,
    fill = label,
    text = paste0(
      "Thread Group: ",         thread_group,
      "\nRun ID: ",             run_id,
      "\nApplication: ",        app_name,
      "\nTransaction: ",        label,
      "\nCount: ",              tx_count, " trx/min",
      "\nTotal This Minute: ",  total_per_minute, " trx/min"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat     = "identity",
    position = "stack",
    width    = 45
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = transaction_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Timeline (Minute Intervals)",
    y = "Transactions Per Minute",
    fill = "Label"
  ) +
  # Place runs side-by-side
  facet_grid(. ~ run_id, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "right",
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    # Style the run_id headers at the top of the columns
    strip.text.x     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", color = NA),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "Consolas", size = 10),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 10),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(family = "Consolas", size = 12, color = "#333", margin = margin(r = 20))
  )

# ============================================================
# 5. CONVERT TO PLOTLY
# ============================================================
tpm_plotly <- ggplotly(tpm_plot, tooltip = "text", height = 550)

# ============================================================
# 6. LAYOUT CONFIG
# ============================================================
tpm_layout_config <- list(
  showlegend = TRUE,
  # Set left margin to 120 to prevent large Y-axis numbers from clipping
  margin     = list(l = 120, r = 40, b = 80, t = 80),
  dragmode   = FALSE,
  hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "white"),
  title      = list(
    text    = paste0(
      "<b>Transactions per Minute</b>",
      "<br><sup>Runs: ", subtitle_text, "</sup>"
    ),
    x       = 0,
    xanchor = "left",
    font    = list(size = 14, family = "Consolas", color = "#333")
  )
)

# Lock the side-by-side axes to prevent accidental zooming/panning safely
for (i in 1:10) {
  x_name <- if (i == 1) "xaxis" else paste0("xaxis", i)
  y_name <- if (i == 1) "yaxis" else paste0("yaxis", i)

  tpm_layout_config[[x_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE)
  tpm_layout_config[[y_name]] <- list(fixedrange = TRUE, automargin = TRUE)
}

tpm_plotly <- do.call(layout, c(list(tpm_plotly), tpm_layout_config)) %>%
  plotly::config(
    responsive     = TRUE,
    displayModeBar = TRUE,
    toImageButtonOptions = list(
      format   = "png",
      filename = paste0("Transactions_Per_Minute_Combined_", Sys.Date()),
      height   = 550,
      width    = 1400
    ),
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = list(
      "zoom2d", "pan2d", "select2d", "lasso2d", "zoomIn2d", "zoomOut2d",
      "autoScale2d", "resetScale2d", "hoverClosestCartesian", "hoverCompareCartesian"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. MOUNT HTML VIEWPORT
# ============================================================
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; padding: 10px;",
    tpm_plotly
  ),
  render_observation_panel(
    chart_id = "chart_tpmVerticalStack"
  )
)
```
